justification: Image A depicts a stacked, sculptural composition of abstract anthropomorphic/animalistic forms with incised linear detailing, while Image B shows a flat rock surface with painted linear glyph-like marks including circles, curved lines and small stick-like figures. There is no correspondence in the kinds of forms depicted (three-dimensional stacked biomorphic mass versus two-dimensional schematic pictographic marks), nor in how any elements relate to or are arranged relative to one another.
